en: Black‑and‑white view over a small European village in a hilly, forested valley. In the foreground are half‑timbered houses and farm plots; at right stands a pointed‑tower church with Gothic‑revival elements. On a hill in the background is a ruined square tower or keep, likely part of a medieval castle. The scene is rural, with winding paths, scattered trees, and wooded hills surrounding the settlement. Faint, reversed handwriting appears along the upper edge.
